request.text:
Employee ticket:
My keyboard types @ when I press the quote key and I can't find the pound sign.

Knowledge base sources:
[1] Keyboard types the wrong symbols · Fix (updated 2026-02-11)
## Fix
If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. On Windows open **Settings > Time & language > Language & region** and set the keyboard to "United Kingdom". On a Mac open **System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources** and add "British".
request.instructions: You write replies for Northwind Labs' IT help desk. Use only the knowledge base sources. If the sources do not answer part of the ticket, say that plainly. Never invent times, dates, causes, approvals or links.

reply.description: A reply to the employee (Windows 11, London) in plain English: one short opening sentence, then the steps to follow as short numbered sentences, taken only from the sources. No greeting line, no sign-off, no script code.

reply.value: If @ and " are swapped, the layout is set to US instead of UK. 1. Open Settings > Time & language > Language & region. 2. Set the keyboard to "United Kingdom"
